jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Summary of the Role:

Maze is a well-funded Series A startup using AI agents to fix vulnerability management for enterprise security teams. We're hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to own the campaigns that make Maze a name security teams know. It's a demand gen role at heart, but the job is bigger than running channels: within a year, every AppSec and cloud security leader we sell to should know who Maze is and what we do.

You'll be a hands-on IC reporting to our VP Marketing, and you'll have impact from your first month, not after a long ramp. The work leans towards brand: influencer partnerships, out-of-home, podcast sponsorships, campaigns built on the week's biggest exploit, and ideas nobody in security has tried yet. Paid search and the rest of the traditional demand gen mix still matter, but spending $100K on Google Ads is not the plan.

The ideal candidate has done this before at a Series A company, as part of an early marketing team where they owned several channels at once. You look at a growth problem and come up with a new way to solve it, not the way it's always been done, and AI is already how you work. Security experience helps, but we'll teach the domain to the right builder.

Your Contributions to Our Journey:

•
Make Maze Known: Plan and run the brand-led campaigns that put Maze in front of security leaders, including influencer partnerships, out-of-home, podcast sponsorships and creative stunts that get talked about

•
Build Growth Campaigns from Scratch: Turn ideas like exploit-driven campaigns or a security job board into shipped programmes, from first idea to launch to results

•
Run the Full Demand Gen Mix: Own campaigns across events, digital, web and paid, sequenced so each channel reinforces the others and feeds pipeline

•
Find and Land Sponsorships: Find the podcasts, newsletters, creators and communities our buyers actually follow, then negotiate and run the partnerships

•
Build Your Own Tools: Use AI and automation to build the dashboards, workflows and reporting you need, so you aren't waiting on anyone to measure what's working

•
Measure What Moves: Track brand reach and share of voice in security alongside the pipeline your campaigns influence, then double down on what works and cut what doesn't

•
Work in Extreme Sync with Sales and Marketing: Partner with our VP Marketing, growth team and sales to make sure campaigns land with the accounts we're selling to

What You Need to Be Successful:

•
3-5 Years in B2B Growth or Demand Gen: You've done the job before, owned results and are ready for a bigger role

•
Early-Stage Startup Experience: You've worked in an early marketing team, ideally at Series A, where you built programmes rather than inheriting them

•
Hands-On IC: You do the work yourself. You don't need a team or an agency underneath you to ship

•
Breadth Across Channels: Real experience across several of paid, events, digital, web, influencers and partnerships. We're not looking for a specialist in a single channel

•
Brand-Leaning Growth Experience: You've run at least some of influencer programmes, out-of-home, podcast or creator sponsorships, or unconventional growth campaigns, and you can tell us what they delivered

•
Builder Mindset: You can point to times you solved a growth problem with a new approach instead of the standard playbook

•
AI-Native Operator: You use LLMs and AI agents for research, creative, analysis and automation every day, because it's how you work

•
Nice to have:

•
Experience marketing to security buyers such as CISOs, AppSec and cloud security teams

•
Background in technical B2B SaaS such as DevOps, cloud infrastructure or developer tools

•
Existing relationships with security podcasts, creators or communities

•
Experience running event programmes, from booths at large conferences to small field events

Why Join Us:

•
Ambitious Challenge: We're building at the intersection of generative AI (LLMs and agents) and cybersecurity, solving one of security's biggest problems: more vulnerability findings than teams can ever work through

•
Define the Brand: The campaigns you run will shape how the security market sees Maze for years. Your creative calls get made, not watered down

•
Expert Team: Work alongside a team of hands-on leaders with experience in Big Tech and Scale-ups, who have been part of the leadership teams behind multiple acquisitions and an IPO

•
Build an AI-native Company: Help design how marketing works in the AI era, starting from scratch

•
Impactful Work: Cybersecurity is a force for good, and your work helps stop cyber attacks against major organisations

jobs.title: Customer & Field Marketing Manager - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

• In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

• PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Opportunity

You own two things that are easy to under-invest in and expensive to ignore: the customers we already have, and the rooms where buyers gather. You run customer and expansion marketing in partnership with Customer Success, and you execute the field and event motion that the segment owners scope.

You also own the proof. References, case studies, and advocates are how we win deals and how an acquirer values us. That program is yours to build.

What You’ll Own

Sales enablement

• Build custom sales decks and assets for client engagements, with a focus on enterprise deals.

• Run broader enablement: operationalize the master pitch and battlecards PMM owns, onboard reps to the materials, and keep deal assets current.

• Be the bridge between marketing’s narrative and what reps actually present in the room.

Field and event execution

• Execute the events the segment owners scope and recommend: booth, on-site meetings, and follow-through.

• Own on-site ROI and the pre- and post-event motion with sales and CS.

References, case studies, and advocacy

• Own the reference and advocacy program; recruit advocates and turn outcomes into proof.

• Partner with Content to produce and PMM for the outcome data.

Field enablement

• Own field and event enablement materials in partnership with PMM’s core positioning.

What You Don’t Own

• New-logo demand creation — the segment owners.

• Which events we attend (the thesis) — segment owners decide; you execute.

• Core positioning and battlecards — PMM.

Key Performance Indicators

• Expansion pipeline influenced. Customer and expansion pipeline, with Customer Success.

• Net revenue retention contribution. Marketing’s influence on retention and expansion.

• Event execution ROI. Pipeline and qualified meetings per event, on budget.

• Proof produced. References and case studies created — exit-critical.

• Field contribution to acute pipeline. Field-influenced pipeline supporting the ABM motion.

What We’re Looking For

• 4+ years in customer marketing, field marketing, or events in B2B SaaS; healthcare IT preferred.

• A program builder who can run events and customer motions at the same time without dropping either.

• Comfort partnering closely with Customer Success and Sales.

• A reference and advocacy track record.

• An AI-first approach to scaling field and customer content.

• Ability to travel up to 25% travel

Nice to Have

• Experience building a customer advocacy or reference program from scratch.

• Experience supporting diligence with customer proof points.

Why Join PerfectServe?
At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $75,000-$85,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.
The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.
We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

• Remote first work environment

• Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.

• 401K - with match and immediately vested.

• 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy

• Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities.

You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management.

What you'll do

Own our conference program

•
Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth

•
Own the events budget and decide where the money goes

•
Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more

•
Plan side events around conferences, such as happy hours, dinners, and meetups

•
Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities

Run field events with sales

•
Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, and regional events with our account executives

•
Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site

•
Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us

•
Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once

Grow our digital events and partnerships

•
Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up

•
Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space

•
Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team

Work across the team

•
Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events

•
Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content

•
Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up

What we're looking for

•
3-4+ years in field marketing, events, or marketing programs at a B2B SaaS company

•
Events you've run that created pipeline, and numbers you can share from them

•
Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once

•
You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan

•
You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you

•
You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it

•
Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors

•
Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events

Nice to have

•
Experience marketing to developers, DevOps, platform engineering, or security teams

•
Existing relationships with organizers of developer and security conferences

•
Experience planning custom booths at large conferences

•
Familiarity with open-source communities or developer meetups

•
Hands-on experience with webinar platforms

Team, values & benefits

•
Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

•
At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

​

Senior Digital Marketing Analyst
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable, and more connected world.
Job Overview
As a member of the Digital Data Networks (DDN) Marketing team, the Senior Digital Marketing Analyst is responsible for driving digital growth by improving product and solution findability, attracting qualified target customers, and converting digital engagement into measurable business opportunities.
Reporting to the Senior Digital Marketing Manager of DDN, this role owns offsite digital channels, including paid search, paid and organic social, engineering and component discovery sites, and eCommerce touchpoints. The Senior Digital Marketing Analyst will drive digital growth initiatives across existing and emerging digital channels by connecting commercial priorities with digital channel execution, customer targeting, content promotion, analytics, and conversion optimization. The role is focused on increasing qualified traffic, engagement, leads, eCommerce opportunities, and revenue potential from target markets and accounts.
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience driving digital growth through owned digital channels, external digital platforms, eCommerce-related initiatives, and content findability, while leading cross-functional partnerships that improve customer engagement and conversion. This person should bring a strong commercial mindset, practical execution capability, and a clear understanding of how engineers, buyers, and target accounts discover, evaluate, and convert through digital touchpoints.
This individual must be effective in cross-functional and matrixed organizations. She/he will be self-directed and able to execute a broad spectrum of digital projects while partnering with multiple stakeholders globally.
Responsibilities
• Translate business priorities, target account needs, and product growth opportunities into actionable digital growth plans.
• Plan, launch, manage, and optimize digital growth across paid search, paid and organic social, engineering communities, component search platforms, distributor sites, and new or emerging digital channels.
• Support eCommerce growth by driving qualified traffic to online buying paths, promoting priority products through digital channels, and identifying opportunities to improve self-service discovery and conversion.
• Collaborate with PMs, sales, and engineering teams to enhance product availability, product recommendations, cross-sell opportunities, and measurable commercial outcomes for eCommerce.
• Improve product and solution findability by leveraging various offsite digital channels.
• Partner with integrated marketing, product marketing, sales, analytics, agencies, and external platform partners to execute digital growth initiatives and improve customer paths from discovery to conversion.
• Test and scale new digital growth opportunities, tools, and external sites that can expand reach, improve engagement, and support measurable business growth.

Background & Qualifications
• BA/BS degree; advanced education and/or relevant coursework preferred.
• At least 8 years of experience in digital marketing, digital growth, performance marketing, eCommerce, or digital platform roles, preferably in B2B technology, industrial, electronics, or distribution-related industries.
• Strong understanding of B2B digital customer journeys, especially how engineers, buyers, and target accounts search for, evaluate, and engage with technical products and solutions online.
• Results-oriented, with a growth mindset and the ability and willingness to challenge the status quo.
• Strong project management skills
• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and leadership skills.
• Proven success in fast-paced and matrixed organizations
• Hands-on experience with digital growth channels and tactics, including paid search, paid and organic social, engineering/community sites, component search platforms, distributor websites, and other external digital promotion channels.
• Experience supporting eCommerce growth initiatives, including traffic generation, product promotion, online customer journeys, digital merchandising, distributor or partner platforms, and conversion improvement.
• Proficient in mainstream digital platforms and tools, including but not limited to Google Ads, SEMrush or similar SEO/SEM tools, social advertising platforms, MS Office, and mainstream AI platforms and tools.
• Strong analytics skills to measure digital growth effectiveness, diagnose funnel gaps, and translate insights into optimization actions that improve findability, engagement, conversion, and business impact.
COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $116,300 - $174,400 (subject to change depending on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits
BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.
EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com . If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
AI at Zapier

At Zapier , we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently .

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: 2026-10-06

Location: Remote (US)

Hi there!

We're looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager. Enterprise to build enterprise GTM for Zapier's next chapter. Your first priorities include standing up enterprise GTM for Sidekick (our newest product), shaping our governance narrative, and equipping Sales to win on technical differentiators. As product and market signals evolve, you'll own positioning and packaging wherever Zapier Enterprise needs the most leverage. You'll report to Jane Zhang, Director of Product Marketing, and partner closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders to bring enterprise Zapier to market.

•
Our Commitment to Applicants

•
Culture and Values at Zapier

•
Zapier Guide to Remote Work

•
Zapier Code of Conduct

•
Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier

About You

•
You've landed product-market fit for a new product before, turning pricing and packaging experiments into a repeatable motion that reached real customers and closed revenue

•
You bring deep product and technical depth - you understand how an MCP or agent-based workflow works and can explain it in plain language for a C-level buyer

•
You have 8+ years in product marketing with meaningful time supporting enterprise sales

•
You're entrepreneurial at enterprise scale - you move quickly with the rigor enterprise deals require, and stay close to what buyers actually need

•
You use data to form strong opinions from customer conversations, deal feedback, and packaging experiments, then bring a clear point of view into the room to drive decisions

•
You're comfortable collaborating async, with clear written updates, tight docs, and strong follow-through

•
You actively use AI tools to work more efficiently - ideally you've built automations yourself

•
You're comfortable with enterprise buyers: shaping proposals, supporting demos, and turning customer feedback into product and GTM inputs - credible with both executives and end-users

Things You’ll Do

•
Lead enterprise GTM strategy for new products like Sidekick, defining commercial packaging from design partnerships through to GA

•
Help shape our enterprise ICP and motion into a focused, repeatable GTM

•
Own our Governance story: how we position things like secure auths, identity management, and safety with agent use

•
Shape our talk track around Zapier's differentiators like fluid determinism, and how they show up in the product

•
Work with our customer advocacy team on case studies and proof points that make the platform tangible for enterprise buyers

•
Bring product-level depth to competitive deals, grounding "why Zapier wins" in specific workflows and features

•
Collaborate with PMMs across narrative and product on positioning, launches, and the stories that support enterprise deals

•
Partner with product and sales to shape and close enterprise opportunities on new platform capabilities

•
Translate product updates into field-ready materials with revenue enablement, and feed deal feedback back to product on commercial readiness

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here .

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com .

Application Deadline:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

jobs.title: Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
About League

League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

Position Summary:

This is a builder role, not a maintainer role — equal parts strategy and execution. You're the most senior growth marketing hire on a team that's re-building its demand generation engine. You'll have the budget, a team, and direct access to leadership to do it.

You'll be marketing into two of the most sought-after B2B buyer groups in health tech: payers with long procurement cycles and multiple clinical/financial stakeholders, and providers balancing patient experience against margin pressure. If you want to prove you can build and run demand gen at enterprise scale, in a category where the sales cycle actually tests your craft, this is that proving ground.

You're inheriting a full, well-funded MarTech stack — Salesforce, Pardot, Bizible, Demandbase, and Qualified — and the website itself, but the job isn't to just run any of it as-is. We want someone who rebuilds how that stack operates to be agentic-first: designing AI agents that pull signal to plan campaigns, launch and sequence them across channels, and continuously test and optimize without manual hand-offs between tools.

What You'll Do:

• Own and optimize our tech stack and website

• Own pipeline generation across paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, lifecycle/email, and account-based marketing

• Continuously test messaging, creative, and campaign structure — and bring examples of non-boilerplate campaigns that actually moved pipeline

• Own reporting: define KPIs and dashboards, and keep pipeline numbers trusted by Sales

• Own the AI-Native Workflow strategy and AI Engine Optimization (AEO): as buyers increasingly use LLMs to research vendors, you have ideas on how to build League's presence in those results

• Strategically partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations

Security-Related Responsibilities

• Compliance with Information Security Policies

• Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities

• Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team

• Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations

What You'll Bring:

• 7+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with real ownership of pipeline outcomes — not just campaign support

• Enterprise background: you've marketed to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders; payer or provider experience is a strong plus

• Hands-on across the full stack: paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, and account-based marketing

• Fluent in the pipeline metrics that matter here — MQL/SQL/SQO conversion, pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity — not just CAC/LTV/ROAS

• Real experience building AI agents or automations, not just prompting a chatbot — bonus if you already gravitate toward MCP-first, Salesforce-native tools

• Strategic and hands-on: you're equally excited to set the plan and execute it

• Bonus: experience with ABM platforms like Demandbase or 6sense

• Bonus: experience in HealthTech, FinTech, InsurTech, or other large enterprise-focused products

CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process.

Compensation range for Canada applicants only

$145,000—$170,000 CAD

AI Fluency & Ways of Working

At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work.

What this means in practice:

• Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation)

• Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use

• Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working

• Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively

• Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information

How this scales by level:

• Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output

• Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes

• Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams

What we look for:

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way

• Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies

• Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment

Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com .

Our Application Process:

Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps

• You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application.

• A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League.

• If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring.

• The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept!

Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques , incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines , including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

jobs.description:
Role: Math Teacher

Job type: Part-Time (12 - 20 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Intended Start Date: ASAP

Who we are:

Think Academy US ( www.TheThinkAcademy.com ), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. At Think Academy, we provide full cycle service to foster local children’s ability to think critically, to strengthen their logic skills, and to help them fulfill their goals through innovative teaching techniques. We believe Love and Technology can make education better. Each week, more than 6 million students are enrolled in TAL's online and offline education platform.

Whom we are looking for:

Think Academy is looking for Part-time Remote Math Teacher. Teachers are expected to understand math concepts, prepare classes based on Think Academy's curriculum, deliver engaging and age-appropriate math lessons, explaining concepts, demonstrating problem-solving techniques, and using various teaching methods to meet the diverse needs of students. Teaching Language is English.

What You Will Do:

• Teach elementary-level mathematics virtually through the Think Academy Teaching Platform.

• Actively engage and manage an online classroom of up to 18 students.

• Prepare and deliver lessons using Think Academy's curriculum and teaching guidance.

• Grade homework and provide other essential teaching-related services.

• Communicate effectively with students and parents, offering timely and personalized feedback.

• Typically work 12-20 hours per week(depending on number of classes you take), primarily during weekends or weekday afternoons.

How You Can Be Qualified:

• Bachelor’s degree or above; All majors are welcome; Education, or STEM-related majors are preferred

• You are still eligible to apply if you are still pursuing or in progress of obtaining a Bachelor's degree

• Prior math teaching experiences is not required, but a plus

• E lementary math competition learning or teaching experience is a plus

• Can commit to at least one whole semester teaching starting from 2026 Spring semester (Summer: June - Aug; Fall: Aug – Dec; Spring: Jan - May)

• Available and willing to work during weekday evenings and weekends

• Super passionate about teaching and education industry, and highly responsible and love to get along with kids

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Pay Range:

• USD 45/hr or CAD 60/hr; teachers will be assigned roughly 3 - 7 classes per week

• Pay Structure: Teaching Fee * Number of Classes + Student Retention Bonus (Targeted at 15% of Teaching Fee) + Training Allowance

• Please ask your recruiter for more information about pay rate

jobs.title: Product Designer – Content Solutions
jobs.description:
Location: Remote — Americas Team (Open to applicants located in North & South America, with the ability to primarily work within US business hours/time zones)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Product Designer at Fueled, you will contribute to solving complex product challenges and shaping them into clear, high-value solutions, particularly within content-rich, CMS-driven environments. You will work closely with teammates and clients alike, helping shape experiences that ship, scale, and support structured content across digital products. This role is for a strong individual contributor who brings a thoughtful point of view, collaborative partnership, and attention to detail.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

• Design end-to-end experiences for content-rich, editorial, and information-heavy web and mobile products, often within CMS-driven and structured content environments.

• Create and contribute to design systems and reusable patterns that support flexible content structures, ensuring scalability, consistency, polish, and long-term quality across projects.

• Collaborate closely with internal cross-discipline teams, contributing to solutions that align product, engineering, and strategy toward cohesive outcomes, while exploring innovative approaches and challenging assumptions.

• Support workshops and presentations as a key design contributor, building trust and credibility through clear storytelling, thoughtful communication, and demonstration of design impact.

• Use motion and interaction design strategically to enhance clarity, guide user attention, and reinforce experiences in ways that communicate intent and craftsmanship.

What you will achieve:

• Deliver design experiences that users trust and teams can scale, turning insight into intuitive solutions across flows, screens, and interactions.

• Bring clarity to complex, ambiguous challenges, helping teams and clients move forward with confidence and reduced friction.

• Strengthen cross-functional alignment, contributing to shared understanding and measurable progress across teams.

• Build client confidence through thoughtful design contributions, clear communication, and well-presented ideas.

• Advance the quality and consistency of design work across projects, using design systems, motion, and interaction to elevate outcomes.

About you:

• You have 3+ years of experience in visual, product, or digital design.

• You thrive in ambiguity, exploring complex challenges with curiosity and turning them into clear, value-driven product experiences, particularly within content-heavy or CMS-driven environments.

• You’re excited by storytelling and strategy, articulating design decisions clearly and confidently to clients and stakeholders.

• You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, contributing to alignment through thoughtful communication and shared problem-solving.

• You bring a high level of care and attention to detail to your work, with pride for design quality, visual craft, interaction, and motion.

jobs.title: Humbly Confident Marketing Lead
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Utah

URL: https://www.chirocat.com/

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

•
Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

•
Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

•
Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

•
Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

•
Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)

•
Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence

•
Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

•
Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

•
Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

•
Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

•
Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

•
Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

•
Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

•
Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

•
Comfort making short-form video

•
Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel!

Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience.

You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often.

And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better.

If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself.

What You'll Do at ChiroCat

At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true.

Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves.

This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team.

A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE:

•
Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor

•
Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!)

•
Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy.

•
Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan.

•
Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot

•
Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly

•
Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems

•
Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself

•
Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open

•
Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.”

•
Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise)

You’re the right fit if:

You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end.

Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless.

You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger.

You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it.

You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better.

You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you.

You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts.

You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand.

You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess.

You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow.

Ready to Apply?

Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026.

TWO IMPORTANT NOTES:

•
We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers.

•
We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute.

WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE):

•
Your resume

•
A cover letter (Yep, we read them!)

•
Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing).

•
Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?”

PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead

Partner Marketing Manager

Remote, North America

As our Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing to, with, and through our partners, building on an established partner strategy. You’ll work closely with our partnerships and marketing teams to bring joint solutions to market, build relationships across our ecosystem, and help partner sellers understand where GrowthLoop fits and when to bring us into a customer conversation. This is a hands-on role: you’ll shape the plan and drive the details that deliver results.

What You'll Do

• Own partner event marketing from planning through follow-up. Turn conferences and joint events into opportunities to reach the right buyers, deepen partner relationships, and create sales conversations.

• Lead co-branded product launches and customer announcements, coordinating the joint story, partner quotes and approvals, content, and promotion.

• Build marketing relationships with priority technology, cloud, and advisory partners. Develop joint campaigns that support shared sales priorities and give partners a reason to introduce GrowthLoop to their customers.

• Help sellers at our strategic partners understand, trust, and recommend GrowthLoop through relevant content, enablement, and opportunities to engage with our team.

• Bring key partner marketing opportunities into GrowthLoop’s broader quarterly marketing plan. Coordinate with partnerships, sales, marketing, and partner teams to deliver joint initiatives with clear owners, timelines, and goals.

• Proactively involve strategic partners in our major marketing announcements by securing endorsements and/or social media amplification and coordinating with content and product marketing.

• Work with content and product marketing to create partner-targeted content and sales materials, including solution one-pagers, decks, and joint customer stories.

• Collaborate with content marketing on co-branded content, such as drafting guest blog posts and lead generation assets (eBooks, whitepapers).

• Run partner campaigns in HubSpot, including audience lists, campaign setup, lead capture, routing, and reporting, so engagement turns into timely sales follow-up.

• Work with sales to track partner engagement, event follow-up, and sales opportunities generated or supported by partner programs. Use the results to improve programs and decide where to focus next.

• Regularly analyze and report on partner engagement and results of partner marketing initiatives.

What You Bring

• 4–6 years of relevant partner marketing experience in enterprise B2B.

• Experience running partner campaigns, joint launches, and event marketing, including lead capture and sales follow-up. You can explain what you owned and how you measured the results.

• Strong relationship-building skills. You can earn a partner’s trust, find a shared opportunity, and get commitments, content, and approvals across the finish line.

• Clear writing and messaging skills, with the ability to turn a joint solution into a story buyers and partner sellers understand. You’re comfortable creating content, collateral, and presentations.

• Strong project management and follow-through. You can coordinate multiple teams, manage competing deadlines, and keep work moving when priorities change.

• You’ve run partner marketing programs that led to customer introductions or sales conversations, and can explain what worked and how you measured it.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform. You’re comfortable setting up campaigns, managing lists and workflows, and tracking results yourself.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

About You

You’re a builder who enjoys turning a shared idea into something real, whether it’s a partner event, a joint launch, or a campaign that opens doors. You take ownership from planning through follow-up, bring clarity when priorities shift, and care about the details that make the work successful. You build trust by listening, communicating directly and kindly, and doing what you say you’ll do. You’re curious about our partners, our customers, and how to do the work better, including using new tools thoughtfully. You pitch in where needed, make the people around you better, and measure success by what the team and our partners achieve together.

What We Offer

The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $125,000–$135,000. Total compensation includes equity.

Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, location, depth of experience, and qualifications.

About the role

In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting the strategy and executing on lifecycle campaigns across all Consensys products. You’ll look for opportunities to ensure we are bringing a level of personalization in our communication to our users such that every touch point is driving value for our customers and the business.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of taking projects from start to finish with deep experience leveraging customer data to inform their strategy. You’ve developed multiple lifecycle programs at scale, have conducted hundreds of A/B tests, and have even launched new lifecycle channels from the ground up.

What You’ll Do:

• Oversee the lifecycle strategy across Consensys’ product offering (e.g. in-app notifications, in-app banners, push notifications, full screen modals,, etc)

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - Identity
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Product Marketing

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $180,000 to $210,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

As Principal Product Marketing Manager for Huntress Managed ITDR and ISPM, you will turn complex identity-security capabilities into clear, compelling reasons for customers and partners to choose Huntress. You will own the product story from positioning and messaging through launches, campaigns, and sales enablement, helping more businesses build identity resilience and respond with confidence when identity-based threats emerge. Our value of Perfect Imperfection will guide how you test ideas, learn from the market, and improve the story without waiting for every answer.

You will work closely with Product Management, Revenue Marketing, Brand, Sales, and security experts to make Managed ITDR and ISPM easier to understand, sell, and adopt. Give a $h*t means spotting gaps in the buyer journey, enablement, or market narrative and taking ownership of the fix. You will stay focused on what changed because of your work, making you Outcome-Obsessed about pipeline, conversion, expansion, and the identity resilience outcome Huntress delivers for customers.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and evolve positioning, messaging, and value propositions that clearly differentiate Huntress Managed ITDR and ISPM in the identity security market and connect them to how the Huntress Platform delivers identity resilience.

• Create and guide content, campaign concepts, and launch materials that connect identity-security capabilities to the problems security teams and service providers need to solve.

• Partner with Product Management to position our identity offerings, shape launch plans, and bring market insight into their product and roadmap strategy.

• Serve as a product subject matter expert and evangelist externally in the market to help generate interest for Huntress

• Develop sales enablement training and resources that help sellers explain identity risk, create pipeline, convert opportunities, and expand existing accounts.

• Collaborate with Revenue Marketing and Brand to identify demand-generation opportunities and choose the programs and channels most likely to move the business forward.

• Use AI in multi-step research, messaging, campaign, and enablement workflows, applying sound judgment to improve speed, quality, and relevance.

What You Bring To The Team:

• You have 8+ years of product marketing experience, including meaningful experience in cybersecurity.

• You understand identity-security concepts and technologies, including identity threat detection and response and identity security posture management, and can translate technical capabilities into useful, differentiated customer messaging.

• You bring a strong understanding of the security industry, identity-based attacks, and hacker tradecraft, along with experience supporting MSP, channel-driven, or enterprise go-to-market motions.

• You have created positioning, messaging, content, and campaign concepts that stand out in the market and resonate with technical and business audiences.

• You are a natural collaborator who takes ownership, navigates changing priorities, and works effectively across Product, Marketing, Sales, and security teams.

• You consider yourself an excellent storyteller. You can turn complex ideas into clear written and spoken communication and partner with design and content teams on assets such as one-pagers, web content, whitepapers, and demo videos.

• You use AI to build reusable, multi-step workflows that support research, analysis, content development, and persuasive presentations while applying strong judgment to the outputs.

What We Offer:

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

jobs.title: IP Lawyer (Trademarks and Copyright)
jobs.description:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for an IP Lawyer to own the protection of our brands. You will handle escalated infringement cases and manage our IP portfolio – mainly trademarks and copyright – from filing to enforcement. You will work closely with our brand protection team, which handles first-line monitoring and complaints, and with external IP agents. This is a hands-on role with a high level of ownership: you will make decisions on cases yourself and help build how IP protection works across our brands.

Key Responsibilities

•
Escalated IP cases. Take over infringement cases that the first line cannot resolve: copies of our websites and content, misuse of our trademarks, infringing ads and domains. Prepare legal letters and cease-and-desist demands, file UDRP and similar domain complaints, and choose the right route for non-standard cases.

•
IP portfolio. Manage our trademarks and copyright: prepare and support filings and registrations, track deadlines, renewals and office actions, and keep the portfolio up to date.

•
Brand strategy. Build an IP protection strategy for each brand: where and what to register, what to monitor and how to enforce.

•
External counsel. Work with external IP agents and lawyers in different countries: set tasks, check the quality of their work and keep track of deadlines and costs.

•
Support the team. Help the first-line team handle more complex cases and review open cases with them regularly.

•
Processes. Keep templates, playbooks and case records up to date, and suggest ways to automate routine work.

Qualifications

•
2+ years of legal practice, ideally in intellectual property, brand protection or a tech or e-commerce company.

•
Experience drafting legal letters, complaints and other legal documents in English.

•
A law degree.

•
English at B1 level or higher – written and spoken.

•
Strong attention to detail and accuracy with deadlines.

•
Ownership: you take a case from start to finish without being reminded.

•
Ability to work independently, prioritise many cases at once and explain legal risk in plain language.

•
Comfortable using AI tools and online research in daily work.

Nice to have

•
Background in intellectual property: trademark filing, copyright, online enforcement or domain disputes (UDRP).

•
Experience with trademark offices such as USPTO, EUIPO and UKIPO.

•
Experience in a subscription, tech or e-commerce business.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

•
Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

•
Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

•
Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

•
Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

•
Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

•
Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

•
Final Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.
