jobs.title: Director, Product Communications and Special Projects
jobs.description:
About Amplify

Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit Amplify.com .

Job Description:

We are looking for a strategic operator and exceptional communicator who can design the connective tissue of a complex, matrixed organization. You will own the operational rhythm of the Product leadership team using strategic communication levers, lead high-priority surge projects, and ensure senior leaders are focused on the most critical strategic trade-offs. If you believe a well-designed meeting, a tightly crafted narrative, and a thoughtful offsite agenda can be the difference between organizational drift and organizational momentum, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities:

1. Communications Architecture & Organizational Rhythm

•
Design and own the communications architecture across the Product team (~400 people) — from CPO leadership touchpoints to multi-day offsites, Product Town Halls, Product QBRs, and planned moments of cross-functional alignment. You think about how Slack communication flows through the Product team and other key channels, and how to improve day-to-day communication practices that elevate work and clarify both decisions and progress. You are not simply scheduling meetings; you are engineering the information flow of the organization.

•
Shape the leadership cadence: Ensure the CPO’s leadership team is spending its time on the thorniest, highest-leverage problems. Design leadership team agendas that drive strategic debate and real decision-making, not status reporting.

•
Reimagine how we convene: Rethink Product town halls, Product all-hands, and QBRs to be authentic, engaging, and aligned to the narratives that matter. Establish planned moments of communication — both internal and with partner functions like Sales, Marketing & Public Affairs, and Customer Experience — that build transparency and confidence in the product planning and execution model.

•
Facilitate quarterly ceremonies and cross-functional touchpoints that surface dependencies, progress, and trade-offs across suites and shared services.

•
Manage and develop a junior team member who supports deck development, research, and communications execution. You set clear priorities, coach in real time on the work itself, and create stretch opportunities that grow their capabilities and extend the reach of the function.

2. Strategic Leverage & Executive Voice

•
Executive communications: Draft internal memos, leadership-facing decks, and department-wide communications that ensure a consistent, motivating narrative from Product leadership.

•
Narrative synthesis: Translate complex product, operational, and pedagogical updates into clear, high-level executive summaries for company leadership and cross-functional partners. Establish and communicate the narratives that align product development with broader company objectives, with a focus on operational excellence in delivery.

•
Information cascading: Ensure strategic decisions from leadership flow to teams without losing context, and that ground-level insights flow up to inform strategy. You act as the connective tissue between the top of the house and the people doing the work.

3. Special Projects & Surge Capacity

•
Lead cross-cutting initiatives that are complex, high-priority, and don’t have another natural home — the projects that fall between functional lines and would otherwise stall. You drive them to completion.

4. Culture Carrier & Organizational Health

•
Serve as a “temperature taker” for the Product function: You have a finger on the pulse of team morale, energy, and engagement across the Product organization. You proactively surface what people are feeling — not just what they’re delivering — and translate those signals into actionable recommendations for leadership.

•
Take action on employee engagement: You analyze quarterly pulse check employee engagement data and EOY engagement data, identifying with product leadership the highest-priority improvement areas and building recommendations for how to improve and how you’ll measure improvement function-wide.

•
Be a culture carrier: Model and reinforce the behaviors and norms that define how Product works at its best. Whether through the tone of a town hall, the design of an offsite, or a one-on-one conversation with a frustrated team lead, you shape the lived experience of the organization.

•
Build trust across the org: Serve as a trusted, neutral point of contact for other departments and for teams across Product who need a place to raise concerns, flag friction, or simply be heard. You create the conditions where people feel seen and where cross-functional decision-making moves faster because relationships are strong.

Who You Are…

•
A Nimble Thinker: You can digest a 50-page research paper and turn it into a 5-slide strategy deck by morning. You move fluidly between the strategic and the tactical.

•
A “Low Ego” Leader: You are equally comfortable presenting to the ELT as you are rolling up your sleeves to fix a spreadsheet or coordinate logistics for a 200-person offsite.

•
An Expert Navigator: You know how to build influence across a matrixed organization to get things done without formal authority. You are the person people turn to when something is stuck.

•
An Operational Strategist: You find deep satisfaction in a perfectly run meeting and a clear, actionable project plan. You see operational design as a form of leadership, not overhead.

•
A Champion and Unifier: You are an internal force that straddles multiple product lines, grade levels, and functions — representing the broader Product organization in cross-functional forums and ensuring alignment across product development initiatives.

•
A Gifted Communicator: You write with precision, present with clarity, and design communications experiences that leave people better informed and more aligned than they were before.

Basic Qualifications:

•
8–10+ years of experience in a high-growth environment plus 5 years of increasing managerial experience (Strategy, Operations, Chief of Staff, Program Management, or Management Consulting), ideally in technology, education, media, or another content-driven business.

•
Proven experience designing organizational operating rhythms — you have built the meeting cadences, planning cycles, and communication architectures that keep complex organizations aligned.

•
Exceptional deck and narrative skills: You are the person leaders turn to when the story needs to land. You can build a board deck, an all-hands presentation, or a strategic memo with equal fluency.

•
Experience operating in a matrixed, cross-functional environment where influence without authority is the primary leadership currency.

•
People management experience: demonstrated ability to directly manage and develop a team member, with a track record of coaching early-career talent and accelerating their growth.

•
K–12 or education context preferred — familiarity with curriculum development, the school adoption cycle, or the general complexity of the American education system is a meaningful advantage.

•
Educational foundation: Undergraduate degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Amplify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Amplify makes employment decisions based on qualifications and merit, and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status.

Amplify is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in connection with the application or hiring process, please email hiringaccommodations@amplify.com .

If you are selected for employment, a background check will be required. As required by state and local laws and district policies, you may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, such as fingerprinting.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - US
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.

Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.

What You'll Do

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them

• Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call

• Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built

• Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools

• Build the measurement and attribution that show clients, and us, how those channels drive each other and which ones are actually producing business

• Run structured betas with real clients, set clear hypotheses up front, and keep iterating until clients would be upset to lose what you've built

• Build the business case for your roadmap and tie it to adoption, retention, and revenue

• Ship with your own engineering and design partners, and work closely with client success and sales so launches land

Who You Are

• 7+ years of product management, including owning a product line end to end where you were accountable for adoption, outcomes, and revenue

• Marketing taste. You can tell great marketing from generic, and you know how a premium brand should and shouldn't show up. You'd catch the post that makes a client look bad before it ships

• Multichannel instincts. You understand how search, content, email, social, and paid work together as a system, and you want to see the numbers move across all of them, not just one

• Experience building marketing technology: products businesses use to grow their own customer base

• Solid SEO fundamentals, and a view of discovery that goes beyond the website to reviews, social, and what people say about a business across the web

• You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, and you own the result

• Close to your customers. You talk to them often and can explain why something matters in their terms

• You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered

• A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage

• You learn fast and use AI as a normal part of how you work: to research, to prototype, and to get to ground truth quickly

Preferred Qualifications

• Product experience at a company serving small businesses or solo operators who judge you on results, such as Shopify, Squarespace, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Square, or Yelp

• You've built email, lifecycle, or campaign tools, or products that generate marketing content with AI

• Hands-on experience with marketing analytics or attribution products

• Familiarity with premium or luxury brands and how they market differently

• Experience at a platform where one change reaches many customers' sites or accounts at once

• A background in content, editorial, or brand work

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Editor, AI and Technology, Deloitte Global Insights
jobs.description:
Job Type: Permanent
Work Model: Remote
Reference code: 133904
Primary Location: Toronto, ON
All Available Locations: Toronto, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

• Have many careers in one Firm.

• Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.

• Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Deloitte Insights is Deloitte’s global publishing imprint for business research and insights. We publish 400+ articles, reports, and multimedia projects annually with the goal of educating, informing, and inspiring Deloitte clients and prospective clients on the business issues that matter most to their strategic agendas. From leadership and workforce evolution, to AI and emerging technologies, to energy resilience and decarbonization, and beyond, Deloitte Insights (DI) publishes data-driven thought leadership for global C-suite and board-level executives across industries.

As a global senior editor and content strategist covering technology and AI for Deloitte Insights, you’ll work with AI and tech subject matter specialists, researchers, data science and visualization professionals, designers, video strategists, and production specialists to develop research and insights projects ranging from reports and articles to infographics and videos. Your responsibilities will include:

•
Leverage AI and technology subject matter expertise, business acumen, and editorial skills to collaborate with Deloitte business leaders, thought leaders, researchers, and marketing teams to develop and execute research and insights projects for the Deloitte global member firm network.

•
Act as a journalist covering a global AI and technology beat, building relationships with Deloitte professionals, amplifying thought leadership, and serving as a trusted advisor on content strategy and insights opportunities.

•
Ensure the intellectual rigor, credibility, and accuracy of published insights by evaluating data sources, methodology, claims, statistics, assumptions, and conclusions in collaboration with researchers and subject matter experts.

•
Evaluate insights projects for novelty in the generative AI era, alignment with audience needs, and relevance to Deloitte’s expertise and business priorities to deliver differentiated client value.

•
Serve as a storytelling strategist, determining the most effective content formats and leveraging multimedia and multimodal approaches across reports, articles, infographics, videos, and dashboards.

•
Adapt content development support as needed, serving as a ghostwriter, editor, infographic copywriter, or scriptwriter, and applying the appropriate level of editorial intervention based on project requirements.

•
Advise authors on messaging, audience engagement, clarity, accuracy, novelty, utility, and editorial best practices while preserving their voice and objectives.

•
Champion business audiences by applying a deep understanding of content consumption behaviors to shape content strategy and delivery.

•
Manage projects through the full content development lifecycle, coordinating with authors, designers, marketers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure objectives, expectations, quality standards, and timelines are met.

•
Edit content for factual accuracy, readability, grammar, punctuation, flow, style, and compliance with SEO and GEO best practices.

•
Utilize generative AI in accordance with firm policies and standards to improve efficiency while maintaining human-led design, development, oversight, and quality assurance.

•
Coach content creators on writing style, language usage, storytelling techniques, editorial standards, and Deloitte Insights production processes.

•
Lead and contribute to storytelling innovation, quality control, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

•
Mentor junior editors, review their work, and uphold editorial excellence and consistency across content.

About the team

Global Growth creates an opportunity for you to build a new perspective and see both Deloitte and our priority clients through a global lens. While collaborating with some of our most experienced leaders and talent across the organization, your voice will influence Deloitte’s strategic direction, growth, brand, and impact in the market. Your network will rapidly expand, and you will create meaningful connections and relationships globally. You will build deep institutional knowledge and gain an understanding of clients’ heart-of-business issues, and Deloitte’s offerings and solutions. Global Growth’s diverse, inclusive, and flexible culture is an opportunity for you to become a role model for agile working.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

• Minimum 8 years of experience in writing, editing, and copyediting content in American English (business journalism experience preferred)

• Bachelor’s degree (preferably in English, literature, journalism, communications, or similar)

• Deep experience in and familiarity with editing AI and tech articles and research reports

• Exceptional editing and copyediting skills, and mastery of US English grammar, conversational phrasing, and Associated Press style, and the ability to clearly and influentially explain edits to authors

• Exceptional writing and oral communication skills; proven ability to translate complex concepts into easily digestible terms

• Excellent attention to detail, laser focus on quality, and demonstrated ability to clarify a story’s main message

• Journalist's instinct for fact-checking and critical thinking; ability to read research with healthy skepticism, ask probing questions about data and methodology, spot logical gaps or overstatements, and ensure precision in language around statistics and research findings

• Outside-in orientation, considering all content projects from the perspective of the target audience and their needs/interests

• Versatile editing and writing skills, from writing engaging headlines and short-form web copy to developmentally editing long-form research reports on complex topics

• Experience with creating multimedia content

• Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, including the confidence to interact with and influence personnel at all levels, as well as listening skills, responsiveness, flexibility, initiative, decision-making, conflict resolution, and tact

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, content management systems, and workflow and collaboration tools such as Workfront, Microsoft Teams, etc.; knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint

• Ability to manage multiple projects with quick turnaround times simultaneously

• Ability to work independently, as well as with a larger, multifunctional team

Preferred:

• Experience working for a business news publication or in a publishing house

• Experience with corporate thought leadership and global, cross-industry content

• Experience working remotely with a global team

Our DI publishing team comprises editors and copy editors, production specialists, designers, and other multimedia publishing professionals located around the world. The global senior editor will report to the DI global editor in chief in the United States.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $215,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.
Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.
We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.
You shape how we make impact.
Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.
Be the leader you want to be
Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.
Have as many careers as you want.
We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.
The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan , Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative .

We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples

jobs.title: Entry-level communications specialist
jobs.description:
The role of a Entry-level communications specialist at Canonical
We’re on the look out for a brilliant B2B Social Media Marketing Manager to join our team and take our communications to the next level. Our social media provides a window between the people who make our products and those who use them. With audiences in the millions, our online communities have the opportunity to talk to us, engage with us, provide feedback and be involved in the world of Ubuntu. From #opensource to coffee on K8s, launch previews to twitter storms over some cool release swag, our marketing team is committed to creating conversations with audiences all over planet earth: developers, tech enthusiasts, security engineers...
The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They prefer to work in an environment that emphasises ownership of campaigns, collaboration, learning, curiosity and a drive to continually improve oneself / the team / the organisation. They love to problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier.
This role sits in the communications team reporting to the director of communications.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
What your day will look like

• Create, schedule and publish content and campaigns across multiple social media channels

• Deliver regular analysis and reporting on social media metrics, content performance and campaigns results

• Support the growth and nurturing of Canonical’s social media audiences, while increasing engagement rates and valuable actions

• Develop flair with copywriting and asset creation to create messaging that aligns with the brand and its personality, and drives audiences towards action

• Be responsible for executing A/B and multivariate growth tests

• Be audience centric, focusing on platform and community moderation, as well as direct audience engagement

• Create awareness on integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content

• Package all of Canonical’s product offerings and educational material creatively, from bare metal, AI, Kubernetes to chats on diversity and CSR.

What we are looking for in you

• Experience managing social media platforms for tech brands, part of a content team or marketing agency

• Hands-on knowledge of social media management tools, an understanding of web analytics tools (social and web)

• Proficiency with at least four social media platforms including LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and Reddit

• An analytical eye and a good sense for the type of content that performs best depending on platform and objective

• Experience with educational content funnels, and using video as a core social media marketing asset

• Exceptional interpersonal skills and aptitude for forging trusting relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong content marketer

• Proven ability to prioritise and differentiate what matters from the noise, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Director, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

About the role

As the search landscape shifts and our market gets more crowded, Help Scout is investing more than ever in paid and performance marketing to accelerate signups, expand brand awareness, and diversify how we reach customers.

It's an exciting time to be here. We've got a best-in-market product story, strong creative assets, and stellar copywriting. What we need now is a strategic owner to take our performance marketing motion from early-stage to a durable growth engine that fuels our self-serve, product-led, and sales-assisted growth. You'll report to the VP of Marketing, setting and executing the strategy for how Help Scout invests in paid channels while building deep partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Product, Support, and company leadership.

In this role, you will:

•
Own performance marketing strategy. Set the quarterly and long-term strategy for how paid, lifecycle, and conversion work together to hit the signups number, defining what's needed from each channel and building the plan B when something's off. You'll be the person leadership turns to for the full picture of paid performance.

•
Move Help Scout upmarket. Own iteration of ad copy, creative, bidding strategy, and budget allocation across paid search and display, and set the bar for how we drive both our horizontal motion for volume and our vertical motion for larger deals.

•
Build the business case for new channels. Identify and evaluate new channel investments, paid social, affiliate, direct mail, OOH, and drive alignment with leadership on where to place new bets and how to measure them.

•
Partner on pipeline outcomes. Work closely with Sales and RevOps to connect paid spend to pipeline and revenue, not just top-of-funnel volume, and make sure channel investment decisions reflect what's actually converting downstream.

•
Partner to grow organic and paid in harmony. Work with content, social, SEO, and AEO to make sure paid and organic acquisition reinforce each other rather than compete for the same ground.

•
Represent Help Scout's performance marketing point of view. Bring an informed perspective on where the paid landscape is heading, and use that expertise to keep Help Scout ahead of a crowded, competitive market.

•
Own our presence in AI-driven discovery. As search shifts toward AI overviews and LLM-based answers, you'll define how Help Scout shows up in that landscape alongside traditional paid and organic search.

•
Shape the future of the function. This is currently an individual contributor role with agency support. You'll build the roadmap for what performance marketing needs to look like over the next 12-18 months, including where headcount should come in as the motion scales.

About you

•
You have at least 7+ years in performance or growth marketing, including experience owning strategy for a B2B SaaS company.

•
You have significant experience in paid/performance marketing, with a track record of owning strategy for B2B SaaS companies – not just executing campaigns.

•
You're an expert across paid channels and know the search landscape and the benchmarks that matter (PPC, CPM, ROAS), and you can identify which channels and investments matter most for the business right now.

•
You have a scrappy, results-driven mindset. You're comfortable working with ambiguity, a modest budget, and a lean marketing team, and you know how to out-creative the competition while also spending in the right way to drive results.

•
You have strong analytical skills, with deep experience in tools like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and attribution platforms, and you know how to turn data into a clear recommendation for leadership.

•
You know how to run rapid experimentation and adapt strategy based on what the data tells you – and you have a plan B ready before you need it.

•
You use AI tools daily to improve your output, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, or scale of what you delivered.

•
You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, know how to communicate and build relationships across a remote, async organization, and can present insights and strategy to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

•
Bonus: you have experience managing an agency and/or direct reports to execute a paid marketing strategy.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here .

Benefits And Perks

•
Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

•
Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

•
12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

•
A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

•
A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

•

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Background

Nash powers the logistics infrastructure behind some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, along with platforms like Shopify and Toast. We are scaling fast, the category is forming around us, and we are building the product marketing function from scratch. We're hiring our first Product Marketing Lead to own positioning, narrative, launches, and the strategic voice of the platform that is becoming foundational to modern commerce.

The Role

This is the strategic seat where positioning, narrative, customer truth, competitive worldview, and launch craft come together. It is also where the next chapter of Nash's product strategy is shaped. Product marketing can take many different forms in different organizations... It can be a function to spit out whitepapers and datasheets, a megaphone for product management, or… it can be something very different: a force multiplier for the whole organization. We're looking for the latter.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (whose career has been building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work as a peer to our Product Team, and alongside our CEO, our CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving cross-functional group across product, engineering, sales, and growth. The bar for taste, craft, and strategic thinking on this team is high, and the trajectory for someone strong in this seat is significant.

How We Think About PMM

The best PMMs sit at the intersection of three rare skills: technical curiosity, business acumen, and creativity.

You don't need to be a coder, but you need to understand technical implementation, tradeoffs, and be able to talk to a technical audience credibly enough to know what they'll ask next.

You don't need to be a salesperson, but you need to read buying behavior, understand the worldview of the decision-maker, and articulate the value of the problem we're resolving (not the value of our product). You talk in the language of the customer, not the language of our company.

You don't need to be a designer or a copywriter, but you need to write narratives with emotional resonance, position with clear differentiation, and find the experiment, the data, or the execution model that actually moves the needle.

The skills are hard enough to find in one person. The harder bar is what you do with them. Great PMM teams are not measured on what they did. They are measured on what they got the company to achieve together. They don't ask the org to enable them. They enable the org. They earn strategic influence by inspiring the company with a common vision, and then get the whole company pulling together in the same direction.

How We Work: AI-Native, By Default

Product marketing at Nash is AI-native and builder-led. We're looking for a PMM who has fundamentally rewired their workflow around AI, not someone who occasionally uses ChatGPT to clean up an email. Someone who reaches for Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Replit, and whatever ships next week as instinctively as they reach for a Google doc.

The reason is straightforward: the speed and surface area of what one product marketer can produce has changed by an order of magnitude in the last eighteen months. Customer interview synthesis, competitive teardowns, narrative iteration, message testing at scale, launch asset production, sales enablement, internal narrative documents: every loop has compressed. We want someone who feels that in their bones and uses it to compound their craft, not replace it.

We still deeply value the soul, the originality, the conviction, and the taste that can only come from a real product marketer who has actually sat with hundreds of customers and built a worldview. But we need to pair that with the velocity AI brings, so insight reaches the org and the market while it still matters.

In practice this looks like having Claude synthesize forty customer calls into the real patterns (and dampening the lone noisy ones) before you write the narrative, running ten message variants against synthetic personas before you brief the real ones, prototyping a launch landing page in Replit on the same day you finalize the positioning, building a competitive intel system that updates itself, and treating prompt craft, model choice, and tool-chaining as part of your PMM practice.

If your reaction to a new AI tool is curiosity and a Saturday afternoon experiment, you'll fit here. If you believe AI will never replace , you probably won't.

What You'll Do

- Own Nash's positioning and narrative across audiences: enterprise retailers, grocers, pharmacies, restaurants, healthcare, platforms, partners, and the broader category we're shaping

- Lead launches end to end, from shaping what gets built and when, through messaging, assets, sales enablement, and post-launch measurement of whether the launch actually moved the business

- Be the most authoritative voice on the customer inside Nash. Distill the full breadth of customer signal into the patterns that matter, so Product can build against truth and Sales can sell against reality

- Own competitive intelligence: a living worldview on every competitor that matters, refreshed continuously, that a Sales rep can use in a deal at 4pm on a Friday

- Build the launch system itself (the cadence, the rituals, the templates, the prompts, the playbooks) so each launch compounds rather than getting reinvented

- Partner with Sales as a strategic peer. Be the deepest student of our market, our buyers, and the problems they're actually trying to solve, and the best teacher of it across the org. But also build the system so your knowledge scales without you: living competitive intel, talk tracks grounded in real customer signal, enablement that a rep can pull from at 4pm on a Friday without pinging anyone. The best PMM isn't the one who answers every ping. It's the one who built the system that made most of them unnecessary.

- Partner with Product as a peer. Challenge the roadmap with customer signal, shape what we build, not just how we describe it

- Equip the org. Pricing, packaging, deal desk, content, web, sales plays: make Nash collectively faster and sharper at every customer touchpoint

- Build and grow the PMM function over time as Nash scales

Requirements

- 8+ years in product marketing or adjacent roles, with shipped work at a high-growth B2B technology company that you can defend in detail (the decisions, the tradeoffs, the outcomes)

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of technical, business, and creative, not just one of the three

- Has owned positioning and launches for a complex platform product (infrastructure, fintech, devtools, data, logistics) where the buyer is technical and the stakes are real

- Active, daily use of Claude (or equivalent LLM) and AI prototyping tools like Replit as the core of your workflow of how you actually get things done, not just a copy editing tool.

- Strong narrative and writing craft. You can hold a worldview in your head and turn it into copy that sticks

- Comfortable in the data. Funnel, deal, pipeline, win/loss; happy to sit in a CRM and pull the truth yourself rather than wait for a dashboard

- Customer-obsessed. You measure your week by how many real customer conversations you had, not how many decks you produced

- Strong opinions, communicated clearly, updated quickly when the evidence changes

- Has built or scaled a PMM function before, or is genuinely ready to do so for the first time

- Bonus: prior experience in logistics, commerce infrastructure, or B2B platforms with a technical buyer; time spent as a PM or in a customer-facing role earlier in your career; built and shipped your own side project using AI tools

- Location: Hybrid remote/in-office, Bay Area preferred, Fully remote considered for right candidate.

How to Apply

Send us your resume, a portfolio or links to launches and positioning work you've owned, and a short note on the launch or narrative you're most proud of and why. If you'd rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through a piece of work, or a Replit prototype of the Nash homepage you'd build instead of ours, that is very much encouraged.

Want to grab our attention and bypass the Recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH - you'll get the benefit of your application instantly notifying us via Slack, and we'll get some much needed testing coverage on our latest PMM-focused claude build:)

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense
jobs.description:
Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base.

This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership.

The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.

Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.

• Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.

• Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.

• Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.

• Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.

• Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.

• Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.

Who You Are:

• 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.

• Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.

• Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.

• Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.

• Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.

• Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.

• Experience owning a program budget and reporting against a pipeline number you are accountable for.

• Excellent written and verbal communication with strong executive presence, and a track record of influencing sales leadership and driving alignment across marketing functions.

• A self-starter who makes confident decisions without a playbook in front of you, and who is comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal and coming back with the plan.

• Hands-on with Salesforce, marketing automation, ABM platforms, and attribution tooling.

• U.S. citizenship required.

• Based in or willing to relocate to the Washington, D.C. metro area, with willingness to travel roughly 40% for events.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

• Generous and competitive benefits package

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities

• Employee-focused best in class onboarding

• Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program

• Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Hybrid

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

$124,000—$165,000 USD

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: http://snout.com

🐶 Our mission

Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout , we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer pet wellness plans, that actually work.

🚀 The opportunity

Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We're a small but mighty startup team and we're on the lookout for an experienced and remote Growth Marketing Manager based in the United States to help turn the interest pet parents show in the clinic into completed plan enrollments.

💻 The role

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you'll be the owner of the pet parent's path to enrollment, from the first flyer they see in an exam room to the moment they complete sign-up. You'll map the prospect journey, build the nurture flows around each appointment, create the in-clinic assets and consumer tools that capture interest, and track what converts. You'll work closely with Clinic Success and Marketing. We don't have an in-house creative team yet, so you'll write your own copy and wireframe your own emails and assets, with support available.

Your impact, measured in plan sales, will be felt by clinics and pet parents alike. Clinic teams get clear, client-facing materials that explain Snout in the exam room and at home. Pet parents get the right information at the right time, so they enroll understanding exactly what their plan covers and start as confident, engaged members. And Snout learns which messages and channels drive enrollment, so we can scale what works and get more pets the care they need.

If you're a builder who likes taking an idea from a blank page to launch, a writer who can turn plan benefits into a clear reason to act, and a marketer who wants to see the numbers behind every send, we'd love to hear from you.

Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.

🛠 What you’ll do

• Own the prospect journey from first lead capture through completed enrollment, mapping lead stages, triggers, timing and handoffs so every pet parent gets a relevant next step

• Build and improve direct-to-client nurture journeys for pre-appointment, post-visit, incomplete enrollment and lapsed prospects, segmented by appointment details, clinic, species, breed, age and behavior

• Expand and maintain Snout's in-clinic assets (flyers, posters and exam-room pieces), each with QR attribution so it can be tested and improved

• Create consumer tools, like pet health guides by species, breed and age, that put Snout's data to work capturing and nurturing prospects

• Design custom assets and journeys for corporate partners alongside the teams who manage those relationships

• Track funnel performance and test messaging, timing and channels to grow plan sales and conversion

💡What we're looking for

• 4+ years experience in growth, conversion, acquisition or lifecycle marketing

• Experience owning a prospect journey from lead capture through completed purchase or enrollment, ideally in a B2B2C or partner-led consumer channel

• Hands-on experience building marketing automation workflows triggered by prospect behavior, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing and funnel reporting

• Strong copywriting, with a portfolio of customer-facing emails, campaigns or landing pages that turn product benefits into clear, conversion-focused messaging

• Ability to wireframe, or ideally build, your own emails, landing pages and marketing assets

• Experience connecting offline touchpoints to online conversion (ex. QR codes or promo codes), and a track record of taking work from first idea through launch

🌟 What will make you stand out

• Pet, veterinary or healthcare industry background

• Experience developing referral, loyalty, member perks or community programs

• Experience turning CX feedback and cancellation reasons into education and engagement campaigns

• Familiarity with Marketo, Customer.io or similar platforms (including SMS or in-app messaging), design tools like Canva or Figma, and AI tools for ideation and execution

💖 Why you should join Snout

• Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care

• Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters

• Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets

• Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

• A fast-moving, startup culture feels overwhelming to you and you aren't comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go

• You'd rather set strategy and brief a creative or ops team than write, design and build the work yourself

• Your experience is mostly paid media or ad budgets; this role grows enrollment through clinic partners, owned channels and in-clinic materials

• You prefer inheriting an established program to building the first version and measuring it from scratch

• You don't live near an airport or have the flexibility to travel quarterly

💸 Compensation

• $120 000 - 140 000 base salary

⚕️ Benefits

• Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits

• Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays

• Paid parental leave

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/snout-growth-marketing-manager

Headquarters: India

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

We're looking for an SEO Content Specialist to help execute our content and AI-first search strategy. You'll build topical authority and create content that ranks on search engines and gets cited by AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Your work will be measured by its impact on traffic, AI visibility and sign-ups, not by how much you publish.

Responsibilities

• Write, edit and refresh content that meets E-E-A-T standards: real expertise, author credibility, accurate sources and first-hand insight.

• Collaborate and work closely with the content team to plan, brief and produce content that supports our search and AI visibility goals.

• Collaborate and work closely with the tech team to implement technical SEO changes, schema and site improvements, and make sure they ship on time.

• Create content frameworks, including templates, brief formats and structure guidelines, so content is consistent, AI-first and easy to produce at scale.

• Track AI visibility and citations against competitors, test new tactics, and adjust the strategy based on what works.

• Improve click-through rates from search by testing and optimising titles, meta descriptions and rich results.

• Make our content AI-first, so it's easy for both search engines and LLMs to retrieve, understand and cite. That means clear answers, structured formats, entity-rich copy and strong source signals.

• Research keywords, entities and search intent, and plan semantically complete content around business goals.

• Build topical maps and pillar-cluster (hub-and-spoke) content structures that establish topical authority in our core areas.

• Own on-page and technical SEO: internal linking, schema markup, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals and site architecture.

• Report monthly on traffic, rankings, CTR, AI visibility and conversions.

• Help execute our AEO and GEO strategy, supporting decisions on which topics, questions and platforms to prioritise so the brand shows up in AI-generated answers.

Qualifications & Experience

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• 3-5 years of experience in SEO content writing or content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Proven experience creating topical maps and content frameworks, and turning them into pillar-cluster content plans.

• Hands-on experience with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and a CMS such as WordPress.

• Solid technical SEO knowledge, including site audits, schema, internal linking, indexation issues and basic HTML.

• A practical understanding of AEO, GEO and how LLMs and AI search engines find and cite content.

• A strong grasp of topical authority, topic clusters, semantic SEO, entities and E-E-A-T.

• Experience executing SEO or content strategies with measurable results.

• Strong ownership, attention to quality and a record of delivering on time.

Details

• Fully remote based in India

• Salary: $15,000-$20,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

• Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)

• Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k

• Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included 🎉), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days

• Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes

• Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

We have 6 stages:

• Prescreen Call with the Talent Team

• Interview with Hiring Manager

• Assignment

• Panel/Final Interview

• Background & Reference Checks

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply today and let us know why. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Junior Copywriter
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading planet-conscious household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

• Joining a creative workshop with the AU creative strategist to brainstorm ideas for a new paid video campaign – and walking out with three concepts you're actually excited to write

• Reviewing performance data on a batch of still ads and rewriting three hooks to test new angles based on what the numbers were telling you

• Writing and submitting five paid social scripts (still and video) hitting the brief deadline with a day to spare

• Attending a prioritisation call to align on which ad concepts to develop next, and flagging a hooky idea you'd been thinking about

• Sitting in on a video review round with the video team, adjusting a script line that wasn't landing in the edit

Let's talk about you

You can write.

This sounds obvious, but it matters. You have a feel for language, rhythm and tone – you know when a sentence is working and when it isn't. You've got some real copywriting experience (even if it's not a lot), and you're already good at matching your voice to a brand's. Crucially, you can write with humour and lightness without it feeling forced. Our tone is a lot of fun to write in, but it takes genuine instinct to pull off.

You're curious about what makes ads work.

You don't need a deep background in performance marketing – we'll teach you the things you don't know. But you need to be genuinely interested in learning. When someone shows you an ad that performed well and explains why, your instinct is to lean in, not tune out. You're the kind of person who thinks about why something catches your eye, why it works, and what might make it land differently.

You're fast-paced and collaborative.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving team. You're comfortable working across multiple briefs, responding to feedback quickly, and jumping into a workshop or prioritisation call and actually contributing. You don't need every detail spelled out before you start, and you communicate proactively when things aren't clear or capacity is getting tight.

You give a crap.

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence – us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We're in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn't be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here's the thing, though – research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don't check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: German-speaking Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central Marketing Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

At saas.group paid acquisition across our portfolio runs through a small network of experienced PPC freelancers. We're looking for a German-speaking Performance Marketing Lead to oversee this: someone who owns the standards, strategy and quality bar for paid across our portfolio, from accounts ranging from small to large monthly budgets. The role goes beyond people-management, with continued hands-on responsibilities. You'll set the systems and direction and lead the freelancer network, but you'll also be in the accounts yourself on the most valuable brands, and you'll be the person we trust to judge whether the work being done is actually good. If you want real ownership of a function where your work impacts 25+ brands, this is that role.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Take ownership of our most valuable paid accounts and demonstrably move performance, while keeping smaller-budget accounts efficient.

• Set a consistent standard across all brand accounts: how campaigns are structured, how conversions are tracked, how performance is reported, so there's a consistent quality bar across the whole portfolio.

• Take over the paid accounts of a newly acquired brand cleanly: audit, tracking check and handover with no performance dip.

Your responsibilities

• Own paid performance strategy and standards across the portfolio, and run the most valuable accounts hands-on yourself (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, and others), including ad copy and landing page testing.

• Lead and support our PPC freelancers: set targets, review accounts, approve budgets, run regular syncs, challenge the "why" behind decisions, and keep the rest of marketing in the loop.

• Advise brands directly on strategy and budget allocation, with the ability to push back, manage expectations and tell a brand honestly when a channel or budget won't deliver.

• Take over newly acquired brands' paid setups and build the systems, documentation and reporting that let performance scale across more brands and freelancers without losing the quality bar.

• Partner closely with our data analytics team on tracking, attribution and the flow of CRM data back into the ad platforms, and support the M&A team on due diligence for paid-heavy acquisition targets.

• Regularly connect with the SEO Team Lead to remain aligned with campaigns and strategies.

What you bring to the table

• Several years owning paid budgets (think €1M+ a year) while staying genuinely hands-on: you can open an account, diagnose it and run the full campaign yourself.

• Demonstrated B2B lead-gen experience on search: comfortable with low conversion volumes, long sales cycles and optimising for lead quality over click counts (B2B SaaS, B2B or adjacent backgrounds such as gaming portfolios are welcome, as long as you can translate them to B2B).

• A track record across very different budget sizes, from a few thousand a month to six figures a month, making small budgets work through sharp targeting and prioritisation rather than leaning on automated bidding.

• Deep Google Ads and Microsoft Ads expertise, strong LinkedIn Ads experience, and the curiosity to pick up new platforms as brands need them. You're also confident with the measurement stack behind paid: GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion imports and CRM integration. Experience with ChatGPT ads is a bonus.

• German at C1 or native: strong enough to write compelling German ad copy, alongside fluent English.

• Genuine AI fluency, and the drive to put it to work. You already use AI tools (Claude especially) in your day-to-day, and you're the kind of person who looks for where they can sharpen paid performance, from research and analysis to campaign and reporting workflows.

What's in it for you

• Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way - with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.
