About AudienceView
AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.
We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.

Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

• We are people first.

• We are innovative.

• We are results-driven.

• We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.

Why we'd want to work with you
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

• Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.

• Email Marketing & Nurture: Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.

• Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.

• Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.

• Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.

• Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.

What you'll need:

• 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience , with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.

• Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.

• Marketing Automation: Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.

• Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).

• Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.

• Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.

• Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

• High-Intent MQLs: Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.

• Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.

• Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates: Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.

• Engagement & Progression: Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.

Why work at AudienceView

• Our work helps bring live experiences to life. From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.

• We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.

• You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale. Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.

• We're remote-first with a live-events heart. Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.

• Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture. The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.

How we hire — our run of show
No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

• Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.

• Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.

• Meet More of the Team (60 minutes): Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.

• Case Study Interview (45 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.

How we use artificial intelligence in hiring
We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.
We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.

Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility
Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.
We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.

How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer
AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.

Ready to join the show?
If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/audienceview-digital-marketing-manager

• Brainstormed ways we can make our impact messaging more resonant and sticky.

• Worked with the Digital Product team on elevating our site experience with A/B testing.

• Written a direct mail insert to encourage people to share our brand with friends.

• Joined our monthly Creative Pin Ups and helped celebrate the team’s work.

• Brainstormed and shared inspiration in the monthly Copy team meeting.

• Joined one of our Creative Team squads to help contribute to the culture of the team.

Let’s talk about you

Performance copywriting is your bread and butter

You’ve honed your performance copywriting skills, excelling at crafting scripts and supporting copy for paid video ads across multiple channels. SEO and social media ad platform experience are essential, but we’re happy to help you build expertise if you have a hunger for learning. Conceptual experience isn’t a must – what’s important is your grasp of our tone of voice and how it comes to life beyond the page. You tailor content for each platform, making sure it’s engaging, on brand and optimised for performance, blending creativity with data-driven insights to drive results.

You’re curious and strategically aware

You ask insightful questions and make sure your work is aligned with marketing strategies and broader business goals. You’ve consistently applied performance marketing best practice across various channels, and you stay up to date with trends and principles so your copy drives results.

You’re self-aware and collaborative

You build strong, positive relationships with your manager, the creative team and cross-functional partners. You know how to work in highly collaborative environments and you’re good at balancing e-commerce goals with tone of voice and creative excellence. Your self-awareness and ability to adapt to different perspectives keep you aligned with business objectives while making teamwork feel seamless.

You’re a time management guru

You thrive in fast-paced environments and manage your time efficiently. With multiple channels to track and new work constantly coming in, you excel under pressure, meeting deadlines and prioritising key tasks. You proactively flag challenges to your manager or project manager, keeping the workflow smooth and the team on track. Your ability to juggle competing priorities is crucial to driving our business objectives and performance goals.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer, SEO/AEO and Experimentation
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview:

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor’s website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You’ll join Cresta’s Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel.

You will own day-to-day execution of Cresta’s Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta’s organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

• Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.

• Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.

• Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.

• Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.

• Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.

• Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.

• Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.

• Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

• Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.

• Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

• Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.

• Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.

• Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.

• Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.

• First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.

• First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

• 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.

• A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.

• Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.

• Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.

• Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.

• Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.

• Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.

• A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

• In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.

• Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.

• Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.

• Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.

• SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.

• Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.

• Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000.

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior GEO & SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a Senior SEO & GEO Specialist to own how buyers find, understand, and evaluate Influ2 through organic and AI search.

Buyers use AI tools alongside search engines, vendor content, and conversations to research solutions and compare options. We want Influ2 to provide accurate, useful information as buyers explore our category, evaluate alternatives, and build their shortlists.

The role is roughly 60% generative engine optimization and 40% traditional organic search. You will own the strategy, run experiments, and turn what you learn into action.

What you’ll do

• Grow AI search visibility. Understand the questions, topics, comparisons, alternatives, and use cases that matter to our buyers, and improve Influ2’s presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Build representative prompt sets and track brand mentions, descriptions, citations, cited sources, and competitors through repeated checks across platforms.

• Turn search demand into useful, cite-worthy content. Identify where we have content gaps and what needs to be created, updated, or restructured. Guide content and product marketing teams on clear definitions, comparisons, FAQs, original data, customer evidence, expert perspectives, and supporting sources. Set the standards and write the briefs; you will not be writing every post yourself.

• Build Influ2’s authority across the web. Understand which sources shape answers to our buyers’ questions and strengthen Influ2’s presence there. Audit how Influ2 and our category are described, correct inaccuracies, and earn relevant coverage across publications, analysts, partners, review sites, comparison content, and communities. Prioritize sources based on evidence from each platform and topic.

• Own technical discoverability across AI and search. Manage crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, rendering, Core Web Vitals, and structured data. Verify that search and AI crawlers can access the content we want surfaced through robots.txt, infrastructure settings, and logs, while managing model-training permissions separately.

• Own the SEO fundamentals. Identify organic search opportunities around the topics and queries that matter to our buyers. Improve and track rankings, impressions, clicks, organic traffic, and conversions, and turn performance data into priorities for content and technical improvements.

• Measure what works and separate meaningful gains from noise. Track AI share of voice, brand accuracy, mentions, citations, referral traffic, organic search performance, conversions, and pipeline. Form hypotheses, establish baselines, and repeat measurements before calling a result. Treat emerging tactics such as llms.txt as experiments, be clear about attribution limits, and scale what produces evidence of impact.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in SEO, with at least the past year focused on AI search visibility. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.

• Demonstrable GEO results. Be ready to explain your baseline, the prompts and platforms you tracked, what you changed, what happened, and how you assessed the results and their limitations.

• Strong technical SEO skills, including structured data, crawl and rendering behavior, log file analysis, site migrations, and Core Web Vitals.

• Fluency with Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, and at least one AI visibility platform such as AthenaHQ, Brand Radar, Profound, Peec AI, or Otterly. Looker and SQL are a real plus.

• Digital PR and outreach experience, with a track record of earning relevant mentions, reviews, and coverage.

• A strong understanding of positioning and category development. You can connect unfamiliar concepts to the language buyers already use.

Skills

• Sound analytical judgment. You use data to make decisions and know how to move forward when the evidence is incomplete.

• Curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to adapt as search products and buyer behavior evolve.

• Comfort working independently, setting priorities, and seeing work through.

What’s in it for you

• Remote work, no fixed hours. Work wherever and whenever you do your best thinking.

• Unlimited vacation policy for your work-life balance.

• Generous parental leave and other thoughtful benefits.

• Well-rounded health package to keep you supported.

• A flat, fast-moving team where your ideas will have impact immediately.

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

About the role

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in Argentina and Uruguay - one of the biggest cattle regions in the world. You’ll be building recognition for Halter’s brand that reaches every farming community, with revenue performance to match. We're making our first moves on the ground and we need a senior leader to build the marketing foundation and be part of our core team.

This role is a key driver of full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the local marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new farmers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing farmers expanding and retained. You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth for years to come.

We want you to own marketing for this region. You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in Argentina and Uruguay - acquire, expand and retain the best farms in one of the best farming regions globally.

Who we are looking for:

•
A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness

•
Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on farm with cattle farmers, and you turn that firsthand understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.

•
A builder and world-class operator. You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment. You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or loose) and learn from that experience

•
Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.

•
First-principles by instinct . You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when the local market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.

•
A strong operator across both brand and demand . You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease

•
Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.

•
AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.

What the role looks like:

•
Strategy & ownership: Own the marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.

•
Organic growth & content. Build content that compounds: SEO-driven farmer resources, owned channels, and organic social that establishes Halter as the trusted voice in cattle, not just a paid acquisition function.

•
Events strategy. This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and farmer gatherings actually move pipeline in AU, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.

•
Case studies & proof . Build a library of farmer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new farmers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.

•
Paid traffic. Work with the global Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on customer acquisition costs (CAC) and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.

•
Enterprise motion. Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in AU specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator farms.

•
Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture. Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to net dollar retention.

•
Brand and tone of voice in-region. Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with Argentinian and Uruguayan farmers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.

•
Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets. Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections AU farmers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.

Our Office First Approach:

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

Why our team loves working at Halter:

•
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

•
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

•
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

•
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We have multiple open roles for communications and storytelling (narrative development) specialists across social media and content production.
Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. It requires process discipline and creative smarts, leadership skills and performance-driven strategy to ensure our content aligns with our business objectives.
The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience translating strategy into impact, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation and AI to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be driven, organized and attentive to detail.
These roles report to the Director/Head of Communications and work in close partnership with the Product Management function, as well as Alliances, Sales and Marketing teams, to communicate key company news and announcements, and manage perception of Canonical and its range of products.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
What your day will look like

• Develop and execute a content marketing strategy that aligns with our business goals, SEO and brand.

• Manage our content calendar end to end, ensuring content is efficiently produced with minimum friction and process clarity.

• Ensure content quality, consistency and brand alignment in everything we produce.

• Collaborate with our web team to optimize content for search and AI engines, building on proven SEO or GEO expertise.

• Monitor and report on KPIs for our content program and use analytics tools to identify improvement opportunities.

• Align messaging to ensure integrated campaign support across channels, working closely with our marketing, product and brand teams

What we are looking for in you

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and work across cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with communications and content strategy, including applied knowledge of content marketing and social media.

• Proven experience creating authoritative and engaging content, or leading large-scale brand campaigns. Portfolio of written work required.

• Strong strategic thinking grounded in consumer insight, audience awareness, and brand understanding.

• Passion for messaging quality and written communication.

• Technical curiosity, and interest in software technology and its challenges.

• A data-driven approach to communications and content, understanding how to measure and present results that are material to the business.

• An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.

We're hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to own HubSpot workflow architecture across our property management SaaS portfolio (ShowMojo and Tenant Turner). This is not an execution-only role: the person in this seat designs and builds the automation logic that drives lifecycle marketing, not just runs pre-built workflows.

This is a contractor position, remote, Philippines-based preferred.

Key Responsibilities
Workflow Architecture

• Design and build multi-branch HubSpot workflows from scratch, not just editing existing sequences

• Architect lead scoring models tailored to property management buyer behavior

• Build segmentation logic specific to the property management vertical (portfolio size, unit count, market, product line — ShowMojo vs. Tenant Turner)

• Design lifecycle-stage email flows: lead nurture, trial/onboarding, activation, upsell/expansion, renewal, win-back

Hubspot Execution

• Keep HubSpot organized with consistent naming and foldering for emails, lists, and campaigns

Content & Landing Pages

• Write email copy for automated email workflows sequences

• Build and publish landing pages in HubSpot's CMS/page tools to support campaigns and lifecycle flows

• Publish blog posts and pages in WordPress

• Ensure workflows, content, and landing pages work as one connected system

Ongoing Optimization

• Run and maintain our lead nurture flows: keep emails, offers, and links current, and test changes that improve engagement and conversions

• Monitor email performance and revise logic accordingly; share the results and make regular optimization recommendations to the team

• Maintain clean data hygiene practices within workflows (list membership, enrollment/re-enrollment logic, suppression rules)

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated HubSpot workflow architecture experience — must be able to design multi-branch automation from a blank canvas, not just configure templates

• Hands-on experience building lead scoring models

• Experience building segmentation strategies (behavioral, firmographic, or lifecycle-based)

• Experience designing lifecycle-stage email flows (nurture through renewal)

• Experience building landing pages in HubSpot's CMS or page builder tools

• Hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: building emails, landing pages, and campaigns

• 3+ years in marketing automation, ideally with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on HubSpot

• Strong B2B email copywriting skills, with samples you can share

• Experience publishing content in WordPress

• A sharp eye for QA: you catch broken links, wrong personalization tokens, and rendering issues before anything goes out

• Comfortable reading email performance data (opens, clicks, conversions) and turning it into clear recommendations

• Organized and proactive, with the communication skills to keep multiple teams aligned on a shared calendar

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, US-hours-adjacent environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience running or maintaining lead nurture and lifecycle email flows

• Experience with UTM tracking and campaign attribution

Ecommerce and Digital Marketing Manager

ACE STAINLESS SUPPLY

Full-time | Fully remote | Worldwide
$10,000–$25,000 USD annually, depending on experience
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM Pacific Time

Build a website that earns its place in the business

Help us turn a ready product catalog into a working carbon steel storefront—and turn our digital marketing into qualified inquiries, orders, and repeat customers.

ACE Stainless Supply distributes stainless steel pipe, valves, fittings, bar, and sheet, serving customers through our Santa Ana, California, and Caldwell, Idaho, operations. We are expanding our digital business with AceCarbonSteel.com, and we want someone who can help build it, launch it, and grow it.

You will report to Erica Biscocho, Director of E-Commerce and Digital Operations. You will work alongside Hafsa in e-commerce and our marketing team, coordinate product information with Funmi, and partner with sales and our technical providers. This is a hands-on role: you will create content, make website improvements, run campaigns, and move launch work through to completion.

Your first major deliverable

Launch design of AceCarbonSteel.com as an operational customer-facing website on January 1, 2027.

Our clean product data is ready. Your work is to transfer it accurately, propose the branding and design, build the shopping experience with the team, and prove that customers can use it successfully. You must bring practical website implementation experience as well as marketing skills.

The January 1 launch takes priority within your first 90 days. Our accelerated launch milestones are:

By November 20, 2026 — Present branding and design proposals for Erica’s approval: visual direction, homepage, category and product page concepts, navigation, mobile layouts, and a dated implementation plan with owners and dependencies.

By December 15, 2026 — Complete the approved design and catalog migration in staging. Configure search, filters, product pages, quote and purchase paths, and measurement tools with the appropriate team members.

By December 30, 2026 — Complete testing and corrections. Submit a documented launch checklist, test results, and outstanding issues for Erica’s go-live approval.

January 1, 2027 — Launch the approved site with working customer journeys, verified inquiry and order routing, and a launch campaign ready to run.

Through the remainder of your first 90 days, monitor the live site, resolve issues, and use actual customer behavior and sales results to prioritize improvements.

What launch ready means

You will own the launch checklist and coordinate technical dependencies early. Before release, the team must verify:

Catalog accuracy: reconcile source and destination record counts; validate product identifiers, descriptions, sizes, materials, units of measure, weights, categories, and approved pricing. Resolve discrepancies with Funmi before publishing.

Customer experience: test navigation, product search and filters, mobile layouts, images, downloads, account access where applicable, and clear paths to request a quote or place an order.

Transactions and handoffs: test quote forms and notifications; validate applicable cart, checkout, payment, tax, freight, and order-confirmation flows with the responsible providers. Confirm that inquiries and orders reach the right Ace team.

Search and measurement: verify page titles, metadata, crawl and indexing settings, sitemap, redirects where needed, and analytics events for product views, inquiries, and purchases. Confirm that staging restrictions are removed at launch.

Operations: document how the team maintains the site, manages incoming inquiries and orders, and reports defects. Complete Erica’s final review before going live.

What you will own after launch

SEO and website conversion

Build keyword and competitor research around how contractors, fabricators, and purchasing teams actually search. Improve category pages, product pages, metadata, internal links, and useful educational content. Use Google Search Console to identify indexing and search issues; use GA4 to find where customers abandon inquiry or purchase paths. Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and complete approved changes.

Social media and content

Own a practical publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Create product features, application explainers, branch updates, customer stories with permission, and promotional content. Produce two YouTube videos per month and repurpose them into shorter clips and posts. Coordinate original footage with branch staff and verify technical claims with the product team.

Email and sales support

Build and execute two Mailchimp campaigns each week, on Monday and Thursday. Segment audiences, maintain contact lists, test links and mobile layouts, and direct customers to relevant products or quote forms. Keep line cards, branch marketing materials, and website promotions current. Work with sales to connect campaign inquiries to follow-up and results.

Brand consistency and execution

Keep messaging, visuals, product information, and calls to action consistent across websites, email, and social channels. Bring concepts and recommendations to Erica, obtain required approvals, and carry approved work through publication. Maintain a shared task board with deadlines, owners, blockers, and next actions.

How we will measure success

Send a concise performance report every Monday by 10:00 AM Pacific Time. Show what changed, what it produced, and what you will do next. Establish baselines and agree on numeric growth targets with Erica during onboarding.

Website revenue and orders by site, with campaign attribution where tracking supports it.

Qualified web inquiries and quote requests; quote-to-order conversion in partnership with sales.

Organic search clicks, relevant search visibility, and progress on indexing or technical issues.

Conversion rates and customer drop-off across product, inquiry, and purchase journeys.

Email clicks, qualified inquiries, and attributable sales; social engagement and referral traffic as supporting measures.

Launch milestones, completed improvements, unresolved blockers, and the next week’s priorities.

Pricing follows Ace’s approved matrix and management direction. You will improve how we present and sell products, coordinating pricing or source-data changes with the people responsible for them.

What you should bring

Examples of websites or e-commerce projects you helped launch, including your actual role in catalog migration, page setup, testing, and release.

Proven SEO and digital marketing work with results you can explain: starting point, actions, timeframe, and business impact.

Hands-on ability in website content management, GA4, Google Search Console, Mailchimp or a comparable platform, and SEO research tools.

Strong written English, visual design judgment, and the ability to create useful graphics and edit video.

Comfort working with structured product data and spreadsheets while protecting specifications, units of measure, and approved pricing.

Clear remote communication, dependable availability during the stated Pacific Time schedule, and the ability to organize several workstreams.

Practical use of AI tools, with human review for product accuracy, brand quality, and original thinking.

Experience with B2B distribution, industrial products, Shopify, ERP-connected storefronts, or INxSQL is a plus. You can learn our products; you should arrive knowing how to execute digital work and demonstrate results.

Why this opportunity

You will work directly with the leader responsible for digital growth, have a prepared catalog to build from, and see your work become a live sales channel. We value people who spot opportunities, propose a solution, follow through, and are candid when something needs attention.

How to apply

Email your résumé and portfolio to tom@acestainless.com with the subject line: ACE Digital Marketing and Ecommerce — Erica will help review candidates and assess the working fit. Erica will be your direct report.

Please include:

Two relevant examples of your work, describing what you personally built or managed and the results.

A short note with three specific opportunities you see for AceStainless.com or the AceCarbonSteel.com launch. Brief bullets are enough.

A brief outline of how you would approach the January 1 launch, including the support you would need and any timing risks.

Your location, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can work the stated Pacific Time schedule.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ace-stainless-supply-social-media-seo-manager-2

About the role

This is an employment marketing role for someone who can make exceptional engineers want to work at Socure. Socure is building AI-native infrastructure for identity, fraud prevention, and trust, and we need your help getting that engineering story out to the places where great technical talent discovers ideas, follows builders, and finds its next challenge.

You will work closely with engineers, technical leaders, recruiting, and marketing to turn APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, and decisioning workflows into a compelling case for joining the team. Your work will show software engineers the problems they can solve here, the systems they can help build, and the ambition behind Socure's mission.

Why this role matters

The best engineers are not looking for generic employer branding. They are looking for hard technical problems, strong peers, meaningful architecture, and a mission worth their time. You will make those things visible - in the communities, publications, developer platforms, social channels, and other talent-rich spaces where engineers actually pay attention.

What you will do

Tell the engineering story

•
Interview engineers and technical leaders, learn how the platform works, and turn real technical work into stories that make top engineers lean in.

•
Write technical content - including engineering blogs, deep dives, architecture stories, technical whitepapers, and recruiting-facing website copy - that makes the work at Socure tangible.

Reach engineers where they are

•
Own an employment-marketing content calendar built around the channels and communities where software engineers discover work, exchange ideas, and decide which companies deserve their attention.

•
Adapt and distribute stories across developer platforms, technical publications, engineering communities, social channels, and other high-signal places where the best talent gathers.

•
Partner with recruiting and employer brand to connect content to talent goals, strengthen candidate interest, and support hard-to-fill engineering hiring.

Make difficult technology compelling

•
Translate APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, decisioning workflows, and cloud-based architectures into accurate, engaging stories for technical audiences.

•
Show why the problems matter, what makes Socure's approach distinctive, and what an engineer could help build next.

Build real subject matter depth

•
Develop enough understanding of Socure's products and platform to write with authority, ask sharp questions, and earn the trust of technical experts.

•
Stay current on AI, fraud, identity, security, and infrastructure trends, and turn them into timely points of view that attract the right people.

How you will work

Collaborate across the company

•
Work with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and technical subject matter experts to find the strongest stories and get them ready for the right audiences.

•
Partner with design, social, and distribution teams to package and place content for reach, credibility, and candidate action.

•
Build a repeatable feedback loop with engineers so the content stays technically honest and genuinely representative of the work.

Raise the bar

•
Protect a high editorial standard for clarity, accuracy, voice, and consistency across every channel.

•
Edit and proofread content from other contributors, and help maintain Socure's content style guide.

Use AI thoughtfully

•
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT's Deep Research to accelerate research, drafting, and technical enablement while keeping human judgment, verification, and editorial quality at the center.

What you bring

•
Demonstrable experience in content writing, technical writing, employer brand, recruiting marketing, or content marketing, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity, fintech, infrastructure, or another technical B2B SaaS environment.

•
Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn and write accurately about APIs, machine learning, and cloud-based architectures.

•
Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for making complex technical work clear, credible, and exciting to software engineers.

•
A portfolio of published technical, engineering, employer-brand, or recruiting content, such as blogs, deep dives, whitepapers, case studies, or similar work.

•
Experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and subject matter experts.

•
Strong editorial and distribution instincts, with comfort owning a content calendar, finding the right audience and channel, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a consistent voice.

•
Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content production is a plus.

If you can understand ambitious engineering work, find the audience that will appreciate it, and make great engineers curious enough to start a conversation, we want to hear from you.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

Marketing Specialist

Remote Worldwide · Full-Time · 8:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time · 90-Day Paid Trial to Start

Required: 4+ years at a marketing agency (a company that serves multiple clients; in-house or freelance-only experience does not count) and fluent English (C1 or above).

The Role: We are hiring a Marketing Specialist to work across both client and Forward Push marketing priorities, taking approved strategy, content, and direction and turning it into accurate, polished work that is executed correctly. That includes creating brand and web assets from approved direction.

This is a hands-on, proactive role. Our AI agents and automations handle more of the repetitive work every month, so this role is not about copying and pasting or scheduling posts. You will run and quality-check our AI-assisted marketing workflows, keep us ahead of what is changing in marketing and AI, test new tools and models, and tell us what we should be doing differently. In your first few months you will also handle hands-on execution, such as publishing, onboarding, and QA. As we automate those tasks, your role grows toward strategy and ideas.

We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to find the answer, test what you learn, document it, and know when a question is needed before moving forward.

This is not an entry-level marketing position. We are looking for someone with enough experience to know what good marketing execution looks like and enough judgment to catch problems before they become rework. Most of all, we want someone who is frustrated that their knowledge is going to waste at their current job and who can’t see room to advance there. You can see how fast technology is changing marketing, and you want to be the person who puts it to work.

What You'll Do

Industry Intelligence & AI Testing

Monitor industry news daily and flag updates that affect Forward Push or our clients, such as AI model releases, Google and algorithm changes, platform updates, and pricing changes.

•
Test new AI models and tools against what we use today, such as comparing models on the same task or trying a new video or image tool, and document what worked, what did not, and what it cost. You will have room to experiment.

•
Challenge the team with ideas. We want someone who says “did you hear about this?” before we do.

Marketing Execution & Publishing

Run our AI-assisted publishing workflows to schedule and publish client and Forward Push social media content across major platforms, including bulk scheduling in GoHighLevel.

•
Create and edit professional headshots from client photos, making sure the likeness is accurate and approved by the client.

•
Write and enter meta titles and descriptions for new website pages and published content.

Client Onboarding & Platform Setup

Own assigned onboarding tasks, including Google Business Profile setup and optimization, social platform setup, YouTube configuration, and Google Drive organization.

Research platform requirements and best practices when something is unfamiliar, then complete the work accurately or confirm questions with Operations before proceeding.

•
Gather and organize the client files and assets our web developer needs for quotes and builds.

Website, Brand & Web Content

•
Help setting up websites for new client, following Forward Push’s SOPs.

•
Create logos and basic brand identity assets (logo, colors, typography) for new clients from approved direction.

•
Create website copy by drafting and editing page copy from AI-generated first drafts and client information, then passing it to the Marketing Quality Lead for review.

•
Create attorney bios by reviewing client intake answers, researching bio layouts for the practice area, and drafting, editing and publishing the bios.

•
Proofread approved website copy for errors, consistency and tone.

•
QA staging websites for copy, links, images, forms and formatting, and give clear written or video feedback to Operations and Web Development.

•
Update client privacy policies, following our SOP, and escalate any legal questions rather than making judgment calls.

AI Video & Voice Production

•
Become Forward Push's internal expert for AI avatars and voices to help out our video editors whenever issues arise.

•
Own setup, testing, troubleshooting, quality control, documentation, and staying current on new features and capabilities in both platforms.

•
Create and refine client avatars and voices, and support the video production team in getting the best possible output from these tools.

Reporting & QA

•
Review client reporting data for accuracy, unusual activity, inconsistencies, or items that need further investigation.

•
Review and edit AI-generated report summaries so they reflect Forward Push's voice, focus on what matters, and are ready for the client-facing team.

Forward Push Marketing & Sales Support

•
Support Forward Push marketing priorities as assigned through Operations, including publishing, content support, and marketing asset creation.

•
Support Sales by assembling and polishing sales decks, proposal materials, case studies, service overviews, conference materials, leave-behinds, and results visuals from existing content and direction.

•
Turn existing information into professional, consistent, presentation-ready materials without needing to own the sales strategy behind them.

Project & Workflow Management

•
Use our Project Management Software to keep assigned tasks accurate and current, and manage deadlines independently.

•
Proactively flag missing information, access issues, blockers, or questions to Operations before they affect a deadline.

•
Research unfamiliar tasks, test when appropriate, and build or improve SOPs so what you learn becomes part of the Forward Push process.

How We Use AI

AI is part of how we work every day. Our AI agents create much of the first-draft content, our Marketing Quality Lead reviews and improves that work, and this role uses AI across images, video, voice, research, and everyday execution.

Your job is not to blindly accept what an AI tool, agent, or another team member gives you. You are still responsible for the finished work. If an image is obviously wrong, a post is scheduled to the wrong account, a voice sounds unnatural, or an avatar does not represent the client well, we expect you to notice.

We want someone who uses AI to work faster and better without allowing it to replace thinking, judgment, or attention to detail.

What We're Looking For

Our perfect candidate for this role is someone already working at a marketing agency and doing great work, but feels limited by how much they can own, learn, influence or earn.

At Forward Push, we don’t allow that to happen to our team members. We believe in giving you ownership, autonomy, platform expertise, and responsibility. This is an environment where you decide what to do based on what’s best for the client.

•

•

•

Strongly Preferred

Nice-to-Haves

What Success Looks Like

You have logged and researched industry updates and delivered at least one tested recommendation.

You are the go-to internal resource for our videos, including setup, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and quality control for client video production. Descript is at an inflection point. We have 50M+ users, genuine product-market fit, and a real opportunity to move upmarket—converting high-fit self-serve users into consolidated enterprise contracts and going after the accounts that belong in our pipeline. As Head of Enterprise Marketing, you'll own that motion end-to-end.

This is a builder role for someone who's done it before: someone who can meticulously understand what's driving inbound interest, identify which accounts to go after and why, and design the campaigns, lifecycle plays, and conversion experiments to bring them in. You'll co-own upmarket pipeline with Sales, partner with Product on the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion, and partner with our in-house Growth/Paid team and RevOps to make sure the whole system is instrumented and accountable.

The raw materials are here—a passionate user community, a strong product, and a large market. This hire shapes what we do with them upmarket.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline Strategy & Execution

• Co-own upmarket pipeline targets with Sales, with shared accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline

• Build and execute an enterprise demand playbook: ICP definition, target account selection, channel mix, offer strategy, and campaign design and execution

• Develop a vertical prioritization framework: define which industries and enterprise segments to pursue, in what order, and with what message

• Design account-based programs with messaging and experiences calibrated to high-fit accounts

• Own and maintain an annual marketing calendar that aligns campaign activity to business milestones, seasonal growth opportunities, and pipeline targets

• Source and manage contract and agency resources as needed

Self-Serve to Enterprise Conversion

• Partner with Product and Sales to identify high-fit self-serve buyers and design conversion experiments that move them toward consolidated contracts

Performance & Measurement

• Build AI-first marketing ops and measurement frameworks that give the team real visibility into what's working

• Report regularly on pipeline contribution, channel efficiency, and program performance

Sales & Cross-functional Partnership

• Partner daily with Sales on account priorities, ABM strategy, and pipeline reviews

• Brief and align with the in-house paid advertising team on enterprise-targeted campaigns

• Co-own enterprise lifecycle with RevOps, ensuring accountability is clear and programs are coordinated

• Own the strategy for high-touch deal acceleration programs—things like executive roundtables and leadership-level events—partnering with Field Marketing on execution

• Contribute to enterprise pricing and packaging strategy alongside Product and Sales, with an eye toward what moves deals forward and expands accounts

WHAT YOU BRING

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 years building or scaling an upmarket or enterprise demand motion

• Experience at a PLG or product-led company—you understand the self-serve-to-enterprise conversion motion and have driven it

• Consumer-to-B2B crossover experience; you know how to market to users who are also buyers

• Strong analytical skills and a track record of building measurement frameworks that actually get used

• Experience co-owning pipeline targets with Sales in an accountable, collaborative way

Preferred Qualifications

• Deep familiarity with modern ABM tooling and CRM/MAP integration

• Experience building, or deeply partnering with, AI-native marketing ops and workflows

• Background in SaaS, media tech, or creative tooling

• Demonstrated ability to design and run conversion experiments across PLG funnels

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Within your first 12 months, you will:

• Launch Descript's enterprise demand motion, with a defined ICP, target account list, vertical prioritization framework, and multi-channel playbook

• Co-own and hit upmarket pipeline targets in partnership with Sales

• Build upon the existing self-serve-to-enterprise conversion experiments with Product, with measurable account progression

• Build a measurement framework that gives the team clear visibility into channel performance, conversion rates, and pipeline attributionCreate and maintain a formal marketing calendar that the broader team runs off of

• Establish a functioning enterprise lifecycle program with RevOps

• Run at least one high-touch deal acceleration program (EBC, roundtable, or CxO event) in partnership with Field Marketing

The base salary range for this role is $180k - $230k/year. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

About Descript

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors ( OpenAI , Andreessen Horowitz , Redpoint Ventures , Spark Capital ).

Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles. For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration. For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative , a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.

• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.

• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.

• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.

• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.

• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.

• Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.

• Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.

• Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring

• A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.

• Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.

• A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.

• Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.

• Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.

• Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.
